subject: Scratch ink now goes through S12b's ink API (no longer device-only)
body: Integrated: scratch paper uses useInkLayer('exam_scratch', '{block_id}:{n}') with S12b's save status and the student's ink settings; the device-only Dexie scratch table is dropped (Dexie v2). Highlights/strike-outs stay device-local as decided. e2e 'timed block' draws a pen stroke, waits for the POST /api/ink/exam_scratch/.../changes 200, and reads item_count 1 back: 5/5 twice on webkit iPad portrait/landscape/phone, chromium laptop, firefox iPad. This resolves the open choice in my done message.
